purpose: Canonical runtime manifest for the complete bilingual classroom-task layer.

language_resolution.en: Use title_en, teacher_prompt_en and canonical metadata fields from the base task record.
language_resolution.zh: Use title_zh and teacher_prompt_zh from the base record; overlay purpose_zh, use_when_zh, expected_thinking_zh, listen_for_zh and variation_zh by task_id.

rules: Resolve concept_id to exactly one runtime task.
Resolve Chinese overlays by task_id only; do not translate live when a stored field exists.
Apply grade-resolution/evidence gating before showing system-specific use notes.
A task is a teaching option and must not be presented as a national norm.
